purpose: Operational runbook for restarting the 2026-08-20-epoch1 run after a crash, sleep, or reboot. Not a results file.
scope_reminder: The owner authorized ONE EPOCH (5736 micro-batch iters at batch_size 1). A resume must finish that epoch and stop, not extend it.

HONEST_LIMITATION_OF_RESUME.what_is_restored: LoRA adapter weights only. Verified on-box 2026-08-20: resuming from the smoke checkpoint reloaded a trained adapter (val loss 0.268 at first eval vs ~0.87 from scratch).
what_is_NOT_restored: AdamW first/second moment estimates — mlx-lm 0.31.3 saves only model.trainable_parameters(), never optimizer state (tuner/trainer.py).
The LR-schedule position — the optimizer's step counter restarts at 0, so the cosine schedule replays from warmup_init (verified: LR read 1.000e-07 on the first resumed iteration).
The data-order permutation — a resumed run re-permutes, so some examples may be seen twice and others not at all within the nominal 'one epoch'.
HONEST_LIMITATION_OF_RESUME.so_a_crashed_night_loses: up to 250 iters of progress (~23 minutes), plus the optimizer momentum warm-up and exact LR continuity. It does NOT lose the trained adapter.
HONEST_LIMITATION_OF_RESUME.optional_lr_continuity_fix: To approximate schedule continuity when resuming at iter N, edit the resumed run's mlx_lora_config.yaml to set lr_schedule.warmup: 0 and lr_schedule.arguments: [<lr at optimizer update N/4>, <1391 - N/4>]. Not done automatically because it is a modelling judgement, not a mechanical one.

monitoring.watch_for_memory_creep: the 'Peak mem' field on each Iter line; ceiling on this box is 12.713 GB (mx.device_info()['max_recommended_working_set_size']). Upstream issue ml-explore/mlx-lm#828 reports per-iteration creep on long LoRA runs.
monitoring.watch_for_silent_truncation: grep 'longer than' <log> — MUST stay empty. convert_to_mlx.py pre-truncates over-length passages so mlx-lm's tail-truncation path (which would amputate the JSON answer) is never reached. Any hit here invalidates the affected examples.

after_it_finishes: Do NOT start a second epoch. The next step is eval.py's real path on the frozen 1,010-row held-out split, then the owner's gate-G1 review.
